subject: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai>, ClearFlow Implementation <impl+clearflow@example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-14T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist

Hi Lena — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for committing to the May pilot for ClearFlow Health. I wanted to get the onboarding runbook on one thread so we have a single source of truth for owners/responsibilities. Attached is a draft scope (clearflow-mvp-scope.pdf) and our starter config (redwood-initial-config.json).

High-level ask for kickoff:
- Confirm primary admin users who need org-level admin + project owner invites.
- Confirm SSO or IDP details (IdP metadata or SCIM is fine).
- Decide whether ClearFlow wants Redwood-managed API keys seeded to an admin project or to provision their own service tokens.
- Provide preferred schedule window for credentials handoff and first API smoke test (30–60 minute window).

Proposed ownership from our side:
- Marissa (CS lead): overall timeline, primary contact for product/feature questions.
- Monica (Implementation PM): invite cadence, training session.
- Rishi (Infra/Eng handoff): API key seeding, rate-limit profile, test tokens.
- Jonas (SRE): infra checks, region pinning, VPC/KMS questions.
- Naomi (Support): runbook & escalation path.

Can you confirm the list of admin emails and whether procurement needs to be looped in on any contract details? If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the admin list and SSO metadata and will lock owners once we have that.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: clearflow-mvp-scope.pdf (3 pages), redwood-initial-config.json (attachment stub)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearFlow Implementation <impl+clearflow@example.com>
Date: 2029-05-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist

Thanks Marissa — excited to get started. Quick answers:
- Admins to invite: lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai, miguel.santos@clearflow.ai (CTO), elise.yang@clearflow.ai (Head of ML Ops).
- We plan to use Okta SAML; attaching the IdP metadata (see inline). Procurement should be looped for any contract-level questions — procurement@clearflow.ai.
- For the pilot we’d prefer Redwood to seed admin API keys to a ClearFlow-admin project for speed; we’ll rotate to our own service tokens in production.

Okta metadata: https://clearflow.okta.com/app/metadata/saml/12345 (we'll share the XML in the drive link).

Tomorrow 10:00 PT works for a short sync. We’ll allocate Miguel and Elise for the call.

—Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director of Product, ClearFlow Health

> Attachment referenced: clearflow-okta-metadata.xml (uploaded to shared drive)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai>, ClearFlow Implementation <impl+clearflow@example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist

Perfect — thanks for the admin list, Lena. I’ve locked the 10:00 PT sync and sent a calendar invite (agenda below). Finalized ownership for the tasks:
- API key seed & test tokens: Rishi (rishi_malhotra).
- Project creation + role mapping (admin, developer, observer): Jonas (jonas_weber).
- Invite cadence & training: Monica (monica_patel).
- Runbook + support SLAs: Naomi (naomi_feldman).

Sync agenda (30m):
1) Intros & scope (5m)
2) SSO onboarding +/- SCIM plan (5m)
3) API seed approach and rate-limit profile (10m)
4) Project/role mapping and invite plan (5m)
5) Next steps & immediate blockers (5m)

Pre-reads: clearflow-mvp-scope.pdf, redwood-initial-config.json, Okta metadata on the shared drive.

Immediate question for Rishi/Jonas: If we seed two admin keys (one for smoke tests, one as emergency admin) is that acceptable from a security standpoint, or should we instead provide scoped developer tokens only and require ClearFlow to create an admin service account post-provisioning? I want to make sure we balance time-to-value with least-privilege best practices.

—Marissa

(Invite: "ClearFlow Redwood Onboarding" 2029-05-15 10:00 PT)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai>
Date: 2029-05-14T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist

Quick technical clarifications:
- Seeding two admin keys is fine for the pilot, but we should:
  1) Make them time-limited (30 days) and mark as "pilot-temp" in metadata.
  2) Create one scoped developer token for initial CI test runs.
- Rate limits: what burst profile does ClearFlow expect? Default pilot profile is 60 req/s with a 20k token/min soft cap; if they expect heavier, we need to request a temporary quota increase.
- Model variant: are they OK starting on r-inference/gpt-medium-2028 or do they require a larger context model? That affects the memory / node size we provision.

Lena — if you can give expected concurrency and sample request size (avg tokens per request), we’ll size pilot capacity.

—Rishi

Looping procurement as requested. I’ll own the training invite and follow-up docs after the sync.

Marissa — can you add a short checklist item for:
- Admin acceptance test (10 min): create project, run a single embedding and a single completion roundtrip, confirm logs appear in tenant console.
- API key rotation plan documented in the runbook (we can use a template).

I’ll also record the session and upload a short 10-min "how to invite users" clip to the shared drive within 48 hours.

—Monica
Implementation Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearflow.ai
Date: 2029-05-14T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant Onboarding: Activation Runbook & API Seed Checklist

Thanks everyone — quick summary & confirmed next steps:
1) Admin list confirmed: lena.ortiz@clearflow.ai, miguel.santos@clearflow.ai, elise.yang@clearflow.ai (Marissa to send invites immediately after SSO config verified).
2) SSO: ClearFlow will share full XML/SCIM details in drive; Jonas to review and confirm mapping by EOD tomorrow.
3) API key seeding: Rishi will create two time-limited admin keys (pilot-temp) + one scoped developer token for CI. Keys expire in 30 days; rotation instructions will be added to the runbook.
4) Pilot capacity: Lena to provide expected concurrency & avg tokens — until then we’ll provision default pilot profile (60 req/s).
5) Acceptance test: Monica to run the admin acceptance test during the 30–60 minute handoff window immediately after keys are seeded. Monica will upload the test checklist and the recorded "how to invite" clip.
6) Procurement: procurement@clearflow.ai added for contract questions.

I’ve attached the final runbook draft and starter config (clearflow-mvp-scope.pdf, redwood-initial-config.json) and a link to the HubSpot deal for reference. DocuSign for the pilot addendum was sent to procurement (DocuSign ID: 3f8a-attach).

If there are no blockers, we’ll proceed with the 10:00 PT sync tomorrow and execute the seed immediately after.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
